settings.heading: Brand Story
settings.text: From everyday essentials to every journey.
settings.body: Built around how you live, work and travel — with trusted quality, thoughtful design and care beyond every purchase.

settings.heading: Where it all began.
settings.text1: Jacky's journey began in 2010, working hands-on with leather and learning how everyday products are truly used.
settings.text2: In 2012 he entered the men's leather goods market with the Canvas Bag — loved for its practicality. In 2013, Jack Studio was officially registered as a brand.

settings.heading: Understand First. Create Better.
settings.quote: We believe the right product and experience begin with understanding real everyday needs.

settings.heading: FROM PRODUCT TO EXPERIENCE
settings.text1: In 2018, we opened our first physical store at AEON Bukit Tinggi and gradually expanded our services to include product care, warranty support, repairs, personalisation and gifting solutions.
settings.text2: In 2024, we further developed our corporate customisation services to provide more personalised solutions for businesses and organisations.

settings.heading: MORE THAN A LEATHER GOODS BRAND
settings.text1: Today, Jack Studio is evolving from a Malaysian men’s leather goods brand into a more complete men’s lifestyle and service brand.
settings.text2: From everyday use, work and travel to meaningful gifting and after-sales care, we aim to provide choices that are more relevant, more personal and more trusted throughout every stage of our customers’ journeys.
